normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only flows into the transfer function body and has no independent security meaning.
The amount parameter only exists to drive the transfer arithmetic.
The gonValue local is the direct result of the unsafe multiplication operation.
The from parameter is only an input index for the transferFrom balance logic.
The to parameter is only an input index for the transferFrom balance logic.
The amount parameter only drives transferFrom allowance and gon arithmetic.
The gonValue local is the direct result of the unsafe multiplication operation.
The spender parameter is only used to key the allowance write.
The value parameter is only stored as the allowance value.
The spender parameter keys the allowance updated by increaseAllowance.
The addedValue parameter is the increment applied to the allowance.
The spender parameter keys the allowance updated by decreaseAllowance.
The subtractedValue parameter is the decrement applied to the allowance.
The oldValue local only caches the allowance read inside decreaseAllowance.
The newOwner parameter is validated and written into the owner state.
The who parameter only indexes the gon balance lookup.
The owner_ parameter only indexes the allowance mapping read.
The spender parameter only indexes the allowance mapping read.
